Kohleria hirsuta

Produces pollen?Yes

Notes

Kohleria hirsuta is a species that is highly variable in nature, over a large distribution area in its native distribution range. This is one of the clones that's been circulating in Sweden in recent years. I've also seen it distributed incorrectly as Kohleria trianae.
